analysis:
This batch contains only documentation: changelog.d/deadline-admission-estimators.md (new) and docs/architecture/inference.md (modified). No executable source, wire protocol, key handling, attestation, or cache storage code is supplied, so none of it could be reviewed. The docs describe provider-local changes to first-token deadline admission estimators in AdmissionRateEstimators.swift: per-step decode pricing, an isolated-prefill rate floor of 1/8 of the startup calibration idle rate, a 30-minute evidence expiry on idle engines, and newest-observation anchoring of measurement age. They also describe a DARKBLOOM_TTFT_ADMISSION_FIXES=0 rollback switch that `darkbloom start` forwards to the launchd-managed provider.

Security relevance is limited to availability and routing. Deadline admission is a local scheduling heuristic. The docs say physical admission, KV reservation, actual deadline expiry, and the reviewed-deadline-calibration per-row charge (ServingQualificationDeadlineEvidence) are unchanged. No change to confidentiality, attestation, authorization (TB-011/T-053), or the prefix-cache threat T-041 is stated. Unreviewed risks: (1) The env-var rollback is operator-controlled local configuration, within the operator-versus-process boundary TB-003, and the docs give no sign that it affects attested or serving authorization. (2) Pricing below the measured rate or treating stale evidence as absent could admit work that misses deadlines, but that is a performance effect and not demonstrated here. (3) The 1/8-floor and step-shape logic is not visible, so a deeper pass on AdmissionRateEstimators.swift would be needed if that code is in the PR. The docs assert correctness of the implementation; nothing here can confirm it. The actual Swift implementation is not in this batch, so the docs' claims remain unverified against code.
